about.text: A semi-hard pecorino of ewe’s milk, made by small farms in Umbria and ripened 40 to 60 days in cool storage. Its curd is set with calf rennet.

links.name: On-farm pecorino and goat cheese in Umbria

sources.text: The on-farm process and its ripening from the first paper; the manufacturer’s process and its 40 days at 12 °C from the second.
